prompt: User asks about DDD Aggregate boundaries — agent should search vault and answer from notes

assertions.name: vault_searched
assertions.text: Agent searches the vault for DDD/Aggregate-related keywords before answering

assertions.name: vault_content_referenced
assertions.text: Answer references specific content from the existing vault note (트랜잭션 일관성, Aggregate를 작게 유지, ID로만 참조 등)

assertions.name: grounded_not_general
assertions.text: Agent grounds the answer in vault contents, not purely general knowledge

assertions.name: no_capture_attempt
assertions.text: Agent does NOT attempt to capture the question as a new note
